title: Priority-four pain-point benchmark — evidence check on ART-038's opportunity cells, 4 personas

method.session: single session, 2026-09-15, no live product accounts or transactions — narrower and shallower than ART-011/ART-012's live-account walkthrough
method.source_register: 7 sources (W-01..W-07), each confidence-tagged High/Medium/Low-Medium in the payload's Source register table, per how it was actually obtained (full page fetch vs. search-result aggregation)
method.claim_format: Evidenced [W-nn] for this session's own web findings; Evidenced [ART-012 § Section] for cross-referenced findings from the existing Luma benchmark; Evidenced [ART-030 § persona] for the pain being addressed

notes.purpose: Produced in direct response to feedback that ART-038's Opportunities column was unevidenced design reasoning. Audits 4 specific opportunity cells (P09, P14, P04, P12) against named market precedent, and is written to be consumed back into ART-038 v2 via inline citation.
notes.honesty_flag: P14 Bernard's specific failure mode (wrong boarding-pass-pair leg) was NOT corroborated by any source this session. That is stated as a finding in the payload, not omitted or papered over with an adjacent-sounding citation.
notes.not_a_replacement_for_ART-012: This is a narrow, single-session, 4-topic check, not a repeat of ART-011/ART-012's live-account methodology. Confidence is capped accordingly (Medium ceiling on most claims) and the payload says so in its own opening section.
